purpose: Teach: 美少女/パラダイス/ウォーキング/トリオ/バーベキュー/ボイス/バンクーバー/愛車

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの好きな絵本に、美少女が出てくるのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know my favorite storybook has the most beautiful girl in it?
lines.style: Warm, reflective. Leaning in with shared fondness. Soft smile in the voice. Speaking to draw him into something she treasures.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、夢のパラダイスを描いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drew a picture of a dream paradise.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Careful, like he's offering something precious. Small but steady voice. Watching to see if she understands.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとウォーキングしようね
lines.en: Sho, would you like to go for a walk with your dad?
lines.style: Gentle invitation. Warm, encouraging tone. Soft attack. The naturalness of suggesting something small and kind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達とトリオで合唱したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I sang in a trio with my friends today.
lines.style: Small, genuine happiness. Sits lightly in the moment. Bright but not loud. Pride without performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんちでバーベキューしましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's have a barbecue at your grandpa's place.
lines.style: Tender, inclusive. Soft opening. The warmth of suggesting family time together. Gentle draw on the verb.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくのお父さんのボイス、テレビに出てたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my dad's voice was on TV today!
lines.style: Bright excitement with genuine wonder. Quick, eager attack. Eyes-wide quality. The delight of discovering something about his dad.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバンクーバー出張に行くんだって
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going on a business trip to Vancouver.
lines.style: Reflective, gentle. Slight pause before the news. Tender tone — noticing this might matter to him. Speaking like she's checking his face.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんの愛車、ピカピカだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my dad's car looks so shiny!
lines.style: Eager, close warmth. Bright observation. Voice right there, like he's showing her something. Simple delight without self-consciousness.
